The '''Z-95ML Headhunter''' was a common [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] variant built as a [[Missile/Legends|missile]] launch platform.<ref name="SWS" /> It was outfitted with additional [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile-racks]] and long range ordnance hard-points.<ref name="DB" />
